lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis giaan na dhiaan hai naa tis dharam dhiaan ||
lines.translation: He has neither spiritual wisdom or meditation; neither Dharmic faith mor meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai nirabhau kahaa kiaa jaanaa abhimaan ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, how can one be fearless? How can he understand egotistical pride?

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਕਿ ਰਹੀ ਕਿਵ ਅਪੜਾ ਹਾਥ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaak rahee kiv apaRaa haath nahee naa paar ||
lines.translation: I am so tired - how can I get there? This ocean has no bottom or end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa saajan se ra(n)gule kis pahi karee pukaar ||
lines.translation: I have no loving companions, whom I can ask for help.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak priu priu je karee mele melanahaar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, crying out, "Beloved, Beloved", we are united with the Uniter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ਸੋ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: jin vichhoRee so melasee gur kai het apaar ||37||
lines.translation: He who separated me, unites me again; my love for the Guru is infinite. ||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paap buraa paapee kau piaaraa ||
lines.translation: Sin is bad, but it is dear to the sinner.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪਿ ਲਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paap lade paape paasaaraa ||
lines.translation: He loads himself with sin, and expands his world through sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: parahar paap pachhaanai aap ||
lines.translation: Sin is far away from one who understands himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis sog vijog sa(n)taap ||
lines.translation: He is not afflicted by sorrow or separation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਬੰਚੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: narak paRa(n)tau kiu rahai kiu ba(n)chai jamakaal ||
lines.translation: How can one avoid falling into hell? How can he cheat the Messenger of Death?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu aavan jaanaa veesarai jhooth buraa khai kaal ||
lines.translation: How can coming and going be forgotten? Falsehood is bad, and death is cruel.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਭੀ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ja(n)jaalee veRiaa bhee ja(n)jaalaa maahi ||
lines.translation: The mind is enveloped by entanglements, and into entanglements it falls.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai kiu chhooteeai paape pachahi pachaahi ||38||
lines.translation: Without the Name, how can anyone be saved? They rot away in sin. ||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਸੈ ਕਊਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir phir phaahee phaasai kaooaa ||
lines.translation: Again and again, the crow falls into the trap.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਹੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir pachhutaanaa ab kiaa hooaa ||
lines.translation: Then he regrets it, but what can he do now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: phaathaa chog chugai nahee boojhai ||
lines.translation: Even though he is trapped, he pecks at the food; he does not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur milai ta aakhee soojhai ||
lines.translation: If he meets the True Guru, then he sees with his eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu machhulee phaathee jam jaal ||
lines.translation: Like a fish, he is caught in the noose of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin gur daate mukat na bhaal ||
lines.translation: Do not seek liberation from anyone else, except the Guru, the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir phir aavai phir phir jaai ||
lines.translation: Over and over again, he comes; over and over again, he goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik ra(n)g rachai rahai liv laai ||
lines.translation: Be absorbed in love for the One Lord, and remain lovingly focused on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਵ ਛੂਟੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: iv chhootai phir phaas na paai ||39||
lines.translation: In this way you shall be saved, and you shall not fall into the trap again. ||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਰਾ ਬੀਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: beeraa beeraa kar rahee beer bhae bairaai ||
lines.translation: She calls out, "Brother, O brother - stay, O brother!" But he becomes a stranger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਰ ਚਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿਣ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: beer chale ghar aapanai bahin birahi jal jaai ||
lines.translation: Her brother departs for his own home, and his sister burns with the pain of separation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟੜੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabul kai ghar betaRee baalee baalai nehi ||
lines.translation: In this world, her father's home, the daughter, the innocent soul bride, loves her Young Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: je loRahi var kaamanee satigur sevahi tehi ||
lines.translation: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul bride, then serve the True Guru with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਲੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਣਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: biralo giaanee boojhanau satigur saach milei ||
lines.translation: How rare are the spiritually wise, who meet the True Guru, and truly understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur haath vadaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||
lines.translation: All glorious greatness rests in the Lord and Master's Hands. He grants them, when He is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲਉ ਬੀਚਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee biralau beechaarasee je ko guramukh hoi ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani; they become Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: ih baanee mahaa purakh kee nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||40||
lines.translation: This is the Bani of the Supreme Being; through it, one dwells within the home of his inner being. ||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਨਿ ਭਨਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਘੜਿ ਘੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਉਸਰੇ ਢਾਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhan bhan ghaReeai ghaR ghaR bhajai dhaahi usaarai usare dhaahai ||
lines.translation: Shattering and breaking apart, He creates and re-creates; creating, He shatters again. He builds up what He has demolished, and demolishes what He has built.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਭਰਿ ਪੋਖੈ ਸਮਰਥ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sar bhar sokhai bhee bhar pokhai samarath veparavaahai ||
lines.translation: He dries up the pools which are full, and fills the dried tanks again. He is all-powerful and independent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bhulaane bhae divaane vin bhaagaa kiaa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, they have gone insane; without destiny, what do they obtain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਕੜੀ ਜਿਨ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh giaan doree prabh pakaRee jin khi(n)chai tin jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs know that God holds the string; wherever He pulls it, they must go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaai sadaa ra(n)g raate bahuR na pachhotaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, are forever imbued with His Love; they never again feel regret.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhabhai bhaalahi guramukh boojhahi taa nij ghar vaasaa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Bhabha: If someone seeks, and then becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to dwell in the home of his own heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhabhai bhaujal maarag vikhaRaa aas niraasaa tareeai ||
lines.translation: Bhabha: The way of the terrifying world-ocean is treacherous. Remain free of hope, in the midst of hope, and you shall cross over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੋ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee aapo cheenhai jeevatiaa iv mareeai ||41||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand himself; in this way, he remains dead while yet alive. ||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa maaiaa kar mue maaiaa kisai na saath ||
lines.translation: Crying out for the wealth and riches of Maya, they die; but Maya does not go along with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਡੁਮਣੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੀ ਆਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)s chalai uth dumano maaiaa bhoolee aath ||
lines.translation: The soul-swan arises and departs, sad and depressed, leaving its wealth behind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man jhoothaa jam johiaa avagun chalahi naal ||
lines.translation: The false mind is hunted by the Messenger of Death; it carries its faults along when it goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟੋ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mahi man ulato marai je gun hovahi naal ||
lines.translation: The mind turns inward, and merges with mind, when it is with virtue.
